report.summary: ESP32-S31 Korvo-1 voice + touch heating panel: four zigbee2mqtt TRV rooms on the board LCD, setpoints published straight to each TRV state topic, one-shot voice commands, SoftAP settings page — builds clean (2.92 MB in a 3.5 MB OTA slot).

report.templateApplied: korvo-heating-panel (own composition in artifacts/template.yaml: drivers/board_audio_codec, drivers/voice_mic_i2s, drivers/board_led_strip, drivers/board_button x2 (adc_button_group, boot_button), behaviors/sntp_time + console/diagnostics baseline; frameworks audio+display+webui+mqtt, partition_table 8mb-voice)

components.name: app_logic
components.role: the product: heating model + MQTT plumbing (heating.cpp), voice vocabulary (heating_voice.cpp), LVGL dashboard on the board LCD with GT1151 touch (heating_ui.cpp), /settings page (heating_web.cpp), strip status + button gestures + factory reset (app_logic.cpp)

pins.4: ES8389 I2S BCLK (voice mic, I2S port 1 listener)
pins.6: ES8389 I2S DIN -> mic data (voice mic)

consoleCommands: heating set <room 0-3> <°C> (no args lists the rooms, their targets and topics)
openQuestions: The Korvo-1 exposes no free GPIO, and its ADC button group is a single iot_button device (SET/MODE/VOL-/VOL+ are not reported individually by the button driver). The spec's SET = push-to-talk and SET+MODE = factory reset therefore cannot be told apart on that group by the framework; I bound push-to-talk + long-press permit-join to the BOOT button and implemented SET+MODE by watching the group's press/release events. If the group's handles are not per-label, the combination degrades to 'hold the group 10 s' — verify on hardware.

GT1151 gives coordinates only (no gesture events), so a tap selects a card and a tap in the selected card's left/right third does −/+; the spec's separate on-screen mic and permit-join icons were not drawn (buttons carry them).
The board's DVP camera (and esp_video's USB-UVC device) were disabled in sdkconfig.defaults to fit the image; the board defaults re-enable the camera, so this is a deliberate override.

partitions.csv was rewritten to a 16 MB layout (3.5 MB OTA slots) because audio+display+mqtt builds a 2.92 MB app that overflows the 8 MB voice table's 2.25 MB slots — the scaffold baseline failed on exactly that.
